content.query:
SELECT 
    C.CustomerID, 
    B.AccountID, 
    A.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE AS BalanceAmountFull_Original,
    A.DEP_F.CONVERSION_RATE AS PesoConversionRate,
    
FROM dw.DEPOSITS_FACT A
LEFT JOIN dw.DimAccount_BU_20240119 B ON A.FORACID = B.AccountID
LEFT JOIN dw.DimCustomerAccount_BU_20240119 C ON B.AccountSK = C.AccountSK
WHERE C.CustomerID = 'R00110848';
